Bug_Title: Double Brace Initialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The code uses Double Brace Initialization to initialize a HashMap, which inherently creates an anonymous inner class. This can lead to memory leaks if the anonymous class holds a reference to an instance of the enclosing class, causing confusion and potential maintenance issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method from the DoubleBraceInitializationExample class, which uses Double Brace Initialization. This results in an anonymous inner class being created, potentially leading to memory leaks, which is undesired behavior that the test aims to expose.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed without any errors, confirming that the bug was not triggered as the output was as expected.
